''See also: [[Raion Raithe Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Raion Raithe is a red-skinned warrior with white hair and three eyes. A member of the [[Titan Force]], he holds the title of [[Knight of The Last Horizon]]. He is a skilled [[Combat Artist]] who utilizes a [[force-blade]] and possesses the ability to perform [[Combat Arts]], such as the [[Dance of a Burning World]]. While analysts have noted his proficiency in mechs and arena combat, some suggest he may be less effective in real-world scenarios outside of his [[Divine Titan]], [[Neth’terith]]. Despite being exiled from the [[Raithe family]], he remains a talented combatant and has experience dissecting massive insectoid creatures and navigating spacecraft through gore. Raion is known for his proud, boisterous personality, often announcing his name and title with dramatic flair. He is also characterized by a sense of optimism and belief in his allies, though he can display a stern or disciplined demeanor when necessary.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Raion is a [[Visiri man]] with scarlet skin, white hair, and three eyes, including a golden third eye on his forehead that glows when scanning. He is often seen wearing a red-plated combat suit and white gloves, sometimes without his helmet. Sunlight-colored energy veins run across his skin.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A dedicated fighter and friend to the narrator, Raion is motivated by a desire to be Captain and a mission to defend the galaxy from the [[D’Niss|D'Niss]]. He is capable of being sympathetic toward those who are mourning and possesses a unique ability to channel the power of friendship through bonds with those who trust him. He is known for doing what he believes is right and has expressed trust in [[Sola Kalter|Sola]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Raion is a friend of the narrator and an ally to [[Omega]], whom he provides lessons on faith. He has met [[Sola Kalter]], with whom he shares a bond of trust, and has fought [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]] in virtual space. Raion is the brother of [[Ryzer Raithe]] and was once exiled from the [[Raithe family]]. He has also engaged in combat with Mua, [[Undermaker]], [[Starhammer]], and [[Aila Escalon|Aila]]'s daughter.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Raion is a mage and skilled combatant who has mastered the Aetheric [[sword]] art known as the [[Dance of a Burning World]]. He utilizes crimson energy, a [[force-blade]] made of red light, and a shield of crimson flame to fight. Additionally, he can pilot the [[Red Divine Titan]] mech and move in a red flash surrounded by a burning crimson [[aura]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Titan Knight}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Raion Raithe is a [[Visiri]] characterized by his white hair, scarlet skin, and three eyes, including a brilliant golden eye located on his forehead.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c10">''The Captain'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c13">''The Captain'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c14">''The Captain'', chapter 14</ref> A mage who wears a red combat suit, Raion aspires to become the Captain and is recognized as one of the galaxy's finest personal combatants.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c14" /> Having mastered an [[Aetheric Combat Art]], he can move in a red flash while surrounded by a burning crimson [[aura]] and utilizing crimson energy.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c14" /> He is capable of summoning a [[Divine Titan]] and serves as the sole living master of the Aetheric [[sword]] art known as [[Dance of a Burning World]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c14" /> In battle, he wields a [[force-blade]] consisting of a three-foot laser-edged plane of bright red light.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c14" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c18">''The Captain'', chapter 18</ref> A member of the [[Titan Knights]] and a [[Knight of The Last Horizon]], he previously served as a Knight of the [[Titan Force]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c16">''The Captain'', chapter 16</ref> While standing with [[Horizon]] and the narrator, whom he considers a friend, Raion met [[Sola Kalter]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c16" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c18" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c19">''The Captain'', chapter 19</ref> Raion takes on freelance bounty contracts and seeks to defend the galaxy from [[Esh’kinaar]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c21">''The Captain'', chapter 21</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Crew of The Last Horizon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|As a member of the crew stationed on the bridge of [[The Last Horizon]], Raion was nearly selected for the role of [[Engineer]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c35">''The Captain'', chapter 35</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c40">''The Captain'', chapter 40</ref> He possesses a crimson bicep and believes that both [[Sola Kalter|Sola]] and the narrator are driven by a fear of dying for nothing.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c38">''The Captain'', chapter 38</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c39">''The Captain'', chapter 39</ref> Clad in a red-plated combat suit without a helmet, Raion is a member of the [[Titan Force]] who utilizes a [[force-blade]] and controls a [[Divine Titan]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c42">''The Captain'', chapter 42</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c43">''The Captain'', chapter 43</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c47">''The Captain'', chapter 47</ref> Despite having mental seals to keep his mind intact, he attempted to control his [[Titan]] but ultimately lost control of the mech, which was cracked and on the verge of [[destruction]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c38" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c45">''The Captain'', chapter 45</ref> Furthermore, Raion maintains the belief that the [[Iron King]] is dead.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c48">''The Captain'', chapter 48</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Combat on Nyron Seven}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|After emerging from [[Horizon]]'s teleportation onto the surface of [[Nyron Seven]], Raion Raithe utilized his [[Combat Art]] known as the [[Dance of a Burning World]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c44">''The Engineer'', chapter 44</ref> He managed to divide [[Undermaker's ship]] by slashing his hand from left to right to create a sheet of fire.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c44" /> Following this, Raion reached his shuttle and later bargained onto a transport ship in an effort to save his best friend.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c45">''The Engineer'', chapter 45</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c50">''The Engineer'', chapter 50</ref> The crimson-faced warrior refuses to rest until the narrator is free.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c50" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c51">''The Engineer'', chapter 51</ref> Raion continues his combat by battling [[Advocates]] in the sky and fighting [[Starhammer]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c52">''The Engineer'', chapter 52</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c53">''The Engineer'', chapter 53</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|After bolting down the hallway, Raion serves as a mentor to [[Omega]] regarding the importance of having faith in friends.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c2">''The Knight'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c3">''The Knight'', chapter 3</ref> Following a need to check on his well-being, Raion was noted for testing [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] during her [[application process]] for [[The Last Horizon]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c4">''The Knight'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c5">''The Knight'', chapter 5</ref> As a Knight who utilizes a [[Divine Titan]], he is capable of igniting his energy to blast through crowds at full speed while fighting without his helmet.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c6">''The Knight'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c7">''The Knight'', chapter 7</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Captain of the Titan Knights}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Raion Raithe serves as the [[Captain of the Titan Knights]] and met the narrator following his [[ritual]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c8">''The Knight'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c10">''The Knight'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c12">''The Knight'', chapter 12</ref> He possesses a third eye that emits a golden glow while scanning and is surrounded by a pure scarlet [[aura]] that looks like a thin layer of flame.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c11">''The Knight'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c12" /> Despite his immense natural talent, Raion was exiled from the [[Raithe family]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c12" /> His parents have retired off-planet, leaving him as the brother of [[Ryzer Raithe]], a senatorial aide who intends to become a Senator.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c13">''The Knight'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c14">''The Knight'', chapter 14</ref> Clad in a [[Titan Force]] uniform, Raion is someone the narrator must inform about the [[D’Niss]] and whom [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]] intends to consult regarding his findings.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c13" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c16">''The Knight'', chapter 16</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Mission on Visiria}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Raion Raithe, also known as [[Red]], is a warrior currently on a mission.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c19">''The Knight'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c20">''The Knight'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c25">''The Knight'', chapter 25</ref> During his combat, he utilizes the [[Dance of a Burning World]] [[technique]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c20" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c27">''The Knight'', chapter 27</ref> He was among several individuals who evacuated their planets before the [[D’Niss invasion]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c23">''The Knight'', chapter 23</ref> Working alone on [[Visiria]], he conducts diplomatic work.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c24">''The Knight'', chapter 24</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c28">''The Knight'', chapter 28</ref> The fighter, who has previously fought Mua, won the second round of his fights.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c28" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c30">''The Knight'', chapter 30</ref> Raion's voice could be heard through the ship's wall speakers.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c28" /> Covered in thick bandages, the original [[Titan Knight]] required time to recover.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c30" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c31">''The Knight'', chapter 31</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c38">''The Knight'', chapter 38</ref> His medical room contains a military-grade laser and a massive drill.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c32">''The Knight'', chapter 32</ref> Though he was almost lost to [[Hesh’ellik]], his [[Combat Art]] is unable to take on a [[D’Niss]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c35">''The Knight'', chapter 35</ref> As a crew member of [[The Last Horizon]] who was not at his post, he is a companion the Captain intends to go after.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c37">''The Knight'', chapter 37</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c41">''The Knight'', chapter 41</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Aboard The Last Horizon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Raion is a three-eyed companion to the narrator who possesses scarlet skin and wears white gloves.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c3">''The Pilot'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c15">''The Pilot'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c18">''The Pilot'', chapter 18</ref> While he has been observed standing with his fists on his hips, he also uses a mech and once guided [[Omega]] away from the [[console]] by placing hands on his shoulder.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c10">''The Pilot'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c12">''The Pilot'', chapter 12</ref> During ship operations, Raion manages the shields by using crimson energy to supplement them.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c14">''The Pilot'', chapter 14</ref> He possesses a damaged [[Divine Titan]] covered in golden veins and is known for piloting the [[Red Divine Titan|Red Titan]] while wearing an armored uniform.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c14" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c28">''The Pilot'', chapter 28</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c30">''The Pilot'', chapter 30</ref> Although he is not currently aboard the ship, the Captain wishes for his presence and expects him to arrive soon.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c20">''The Pilot'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c24">''The Pilot'', chapter 24</ref> Acting on what he believes is right, Raion made a request that resulted in [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]] sparing [[Ryzer Raithe|Ryzer]]'s life.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c26">''The Pilot'', chapter 26</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c27">''The Pilot'', chapter 27</ref> Having grown more capable since his battle with the [[Iron King]], Raion also expresses his trust in [[Sola Kalter|Sola]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c32">''The Pilot'', chapter 32</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c35">''The Pilot'', chapter 35</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">19</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Raion Raithe|Raion]] is a three-eyed individual who accompanies the narrator.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The narrator suspects [[Rellask]] has 'seen too much Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion' in him.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c7">''The Pilot'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Return from Shadow Ark}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Having recently returned from [[Shadow Ark]], Raion announced that [[Omega]] would eventually find out.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c40">''The Pilot'', chapter 40</ref> An ally of [[Omega]], Raion is the type of individual whom the narrator leaves to handle one-on-one showdowns.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c44">''The Pilot'', chapter 44</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c47">''The Pilot'', chapter 47</ref> During a battle against [[Aila Escalon|Aila]]'s daughter, Raion found himself fighting with his mech down.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c47" /> Despite his combat involvement, he would not seek to conquer planets and instead attempted to persuade [[Horizon]] to allow him back into the fight.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48">''The Pilot'', chapter 48</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c49">''The Pilot'', chapter 49</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Raion Raithe|Raion]] is fighting [[Aila Escalon|Aila]]'s daughter and his mech is down.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c47" />}}</li>
